caption: The drawing depicts a toy steam locomotive, viewed from the side. The locomotive features a cab at the rear, painted in red with faded areas revealing a metallic or grey base, and four rectangular windows with rounded tops, two on each visible side. The roof of the cab is flat and painted blue. The boiler section is black with signs of wear and distress, and a red cylindrical smokestack with a black cap is situated at the front, along with brass-colored fixtures and a headlamp. Metal looping rods or tubes, painted red, sit atop the boiler. The cowcatcher at the front is painted red, with silver worn areas. The body of the locomotive, including steps and a side skirt, is green with visible scuffing. The locomotive stands on four spoked wheels, brownish in color, with two larger rear wheels and two smaller front wheels. The background is a plain, light beige.
title: Toy Locomotive
